### Note

- Static output is the default and has no `Static` suffix. Variable archives use the `-VF` suffix.
- NFMono and NFPropo release packages contain only unhinted static fonts and do not have CJK or variable release variants.
- The complete machine-readable matrix is available in [`release-manifest.json`](https://<url>/release-manifest.json).
